title: Research reset and evidence synthesis

failure_modes.mode: low win rate vs 1.5/2 ATR geometry

failure_modes.evidence: Phase16 E unstable, pooled F weak, G means negative all horizons; H fades by 12 bars.
E/F/G friction .83/.76/.86 ATR/trade; all canonical gross-negative.
BUY weaker A-H; held-out I reverses ordering; both sides lose.
All E/F/G volatility tertiles and A-H legacy/CAS slices negative; I fails separate period.
Every first and second half gross/net negative.
A had 357 repeats; D removed them but remained gross-negative.
Full samples 92-484; only subgroups are sometimes sparse.
Only 27 confounded CAS sessions; I Muhurat had zero trades.

cost_vs_edge.conclusion: GROSS DIRECTIONAL EDGE GENERALLY ABSENT; COSTS MATERIAL BUT SECONDARY

side_analysis.evidence: SELL better A-H but still negative; I BUY less bad. No stable side edge.

entry_edge.conclusion: C: BOTH; ENTRY TIMING/SELECTION PRIMARY, EXIT-GEOMETRY CAUSALITY NOT ESTABLISHED
entry_edge.evidence: Weak/unstable returns vs friction plus frequent modest pre-stop favorable excursion and reversal; conditioned/censored MFE/MAE cannot isolate exits.

timeframe.evidence: Weak 5-60m persistence, reversals, stop dominance and high friction are consistent with noise; no alternate timeframe tested.

single_instrument.conclusion: MULTIPLE INSTRUMENTS REQUIRED FOR FUTURE WORK
single_instrument.evidence: SBIN-only evidence cannot separate strategy from instrument failure and has no cross-sectional replication.

overfitting_risk.evidence: Seven families, repeated SBIN reuse, adaptive hypotheses and detailed subgroup/forensic inspection; both histories now exposed.

decision_matrix.data: slower multi-instrument panel plus two held-outs

selected_direction.recommendation: Pause strategy development until a stronger structural economic hypothesis is defined and preregistered.
selected_direction.broad_future_question: Does slower-timescale directional persistence across a rule-selected basket of liquid NSE instruments survive realistic costs?

future_protocol.development: Rule-selected multi-instrument panel; objective universe/timeframe/data-quality rules frozen before acquisition; earliest chronological block only.
future_protocol.first_held_out: Strictly later non-overlapping sealed block; one canonical run after hash/spec/integrity gates.
future_protocol.second_held_out: Further later non-overlapping sealed block, opened only after unchanged first-stage pass; one confirmation run.
future_protocol.exposure_tracking: Hashes, metadata, first-open time, role, all exposures and pristine/exposed state.
future_protocol.preregistration: Freeze mechanism, universe/timeframe rules, economics, metrics, sample/decision gates, diagnostics, code hash and defect handling.
future_protocol.one_run_rule: One canonical execution per frozen hypothesis per held-out stage; defects block classification and require unexposed data.

stop_conditions: No falsifiable structural mechanism independent of A-I diagnostics.
Negative gross expectancy at a preregistered held-out gate; no exposed-sample rescue.
Failure across required multiple instruments and first held-out panel.
Failure at the preregistered slower timeframe across multiple instruments.
Post-hoc subgroup dominance or unprovable pristine validation provenance.
No new named strategy based only on an attractive descriptive pocket.
recommended_phase22: Economic-hypothesis and protocol preregistration only; no acquisition and no strategy execution.
